responsibility: Implements the GNU Modula-2 Selective runtime wrapper around host select(2)-style I/O multiplexing and timeval/fd_set manipulation for the mc bootstrap library. It exposes Modula-2-callable helpers to allocate, initialize, inspect, and free timeval and fd_set objects, invoke select and gettimeofday when available, perform simple raw byte reads and writes, and provide portable stub fallbacks on hosts without select support.
